title: IAEA Live Chart: 137Cs half-life 30.08 Y (uncertainty from the seconds column)
summary: The Live Chart row for 137Cs lists half-life 30.08 with unit Y. The seconds columns fix the absolute uncertainty at 0.09 years.
body: The IAEA Live Chart ground-state row for 137Cs (Z=55, N=82), extracted 2026-11-18, lists half_life 30.08, unit_hl Y, unc_hl 9, half_life_sec 949232333.3157274, and unc_hls 2840123.33771328. Dividing half_life_sec by half_life gives 31556926 seconds per unit, so unit code Y is years in this row. Dividing unc_hls by that same number gives an absolute uncertainty of 0.09 years. The small integer unc_hl (9) matches that absolute uncertainty as 9 in the last significant place of the printed half-life, not as 9 years on its own. The leading decay field is B- at 100 percent. The row's ENSDF publication cut-off field is 1-Oct-2006. This is the database row, not a new laboratory measurement made for this card.

sources.title: IAEA Live Chart ground state 137Cs
sources.author: International Atomic Energy Agency, Live Chart of Nuclides

history.note: Truth gate ceiling. The only source host is iaea.org, class other, whose ceiling is weak. The Live Chart row was not changed and no source was added.

Linked the October 2023 NNDC wallet-card half-life world.physics.nndc-cs-137-half-life. The IAEA numerals in this card were not rewritten. iaea.org remains class other, so this card's evidence stays weak.
